name: Advanced Alembic
description: An advanced alembic that requires a recipe. It can only be built on a furnace, with two conveyor belt inputs, one pipeline input and one pipeline output.

name: Advanced Athanor
description: An upgraded Athanor. Add catalysts to adjust recipe outcomes. It is compatible with standard Athanor recipes; when using them, heat consumption remains the same as a standard Athanor.

name: Advanced Blender
description: An advanced blender that requires a recipe. It has two conveyor belt inputs, one pipeline input and one conveyor belt output.

name: Advanced Cauldron
description: A cauldron forged from pure silver. Less a tool than a mark of true mastery in the alchemical arts.

name: Advanced Shaper
description: An advanced shaper that requires a recipe. It has five conveyor belt inputs, two pipeline inputs and one conveyor belt output, and the product is crafted gradually as materials are fed in.

name: Arcane Shaper
description: An advanced shaper that requires a recipe. It has nine conveyor belt inputs and one conveyor belt output, and the product is crafted gradually as materials are fed in.

name: Alembic
description: An alembic that requires a recipe. It can only be built on a furnace, with one conveyor belt input, one pipeline input and one pipeline output.

name: Arcane Processor
description: An advanced processing device that requires a recipe. It has one conveyor belt input and one conveyor belt output.

name: Assembler
description: An advanced processing device that requires a recipe. It has two conveyor belt inputs and one conveyor belt output.

name: Athanor
description: An advanced athanor with a chance of failure. It has two conveyor outputs, and failed products go through the second output.

name: Bank Portal
description: A device used to convert back and forth between two different coins, with the ability to set the amount of coins output each time.

name: Blender
description: An advanced Blender that requires a recipe. It has one conveyor belt input, one pipeline input and one conveyor belt output.

name: Brew Barrel
description: Blends different liquids into unique beverages, then serves the finished products to customers.

name: Cauldron
description: A traditional alchemy device that takes any three materials and refines them into one unknown material. Some old alchemists still insist on using it.

name: Crucible
description: Automated heating device that can only be built on a furnace, with one conveyor belt input and one conveyor belt output.

name: Dispatch Portal
description: A portal that can send goods to the purchaser and receive payment. The corresponding purchase contract must first be unlocked.

name: Enhanced Grinder
description: A more efficient grinder, working at twice the speed of a regular one.

name: Extractor
description: Automated extraction device with one conveyor belt input and one pipeline output.

name: Grand Portal
description: A portal connecting distant cities, allowing customers from across the land to quickly reach the shop. Building more will not increase customer traffic.

name: Grinder
description: Automated grinding device with one conveyor belt input and one conveyor belt output.

name: Iron Smelter
description: It consumes iron ore to smelt iron ingots and can only be built on a furnace and has a conveyor belt output.

name: Kiln
description: An advanced heating device that requires a recipe. It can only be built on a furnace, with one conveyor belt input and one conveyor belt output.

name: Nursery
description: An automatic herbal production device. Spread seeds and add fertilizer to grow the corresponding herbs.

name: Advanced Assembler
description: An advanced processing device that requires a recipe. It has three conveyor belt inputs, one pipeline input and one conveyor belt output.

name: Paradox Crucible
description: A passive heating device that can refine any material into oblivion essence. Different materials will take different amounts of time to refine.

name: Portal (Input)
description: A portal capable of receiving any item input.

name: Portal (Output)
description: A portal capable of outputting any items.

name: Processor
description: An advanced processing device that requires a recipe. It has one conveyor belt input and one conveyor belt output.

name: Purchasing Portal
description: A purchasing portal available only to senior members of the Alchemy Association. Input the required money to acquire the corresponding items.

name: Refiner
description: An automated refining device with two conveyor belt inputs and one conveyor belt output.

name: Shaper
description: An advanced shaper that requires a recipe. It has six conveyor belt inputs and one conveyor belt output, and the product is crafted gradually as materials are fed in.

name: Stackable Crucible
description: An automated heater that transfers heat to the device above it.

name: Steam Heating Pad
description: A fuel-free heating station. Feed it steam to heat the equipment above.

name: Stone Crusher
description: It consumes limestone to produce rubbles, and has one conveyor belt input and one conveyor belt output.

name: Blast Furnace
description: An advanced heating device with a larger heating area. It can automatically refill fuel through a conveyor belt.

name: Stone Furnace
description: A simple heating device. After adding fuel, the devices above the stone furnace can be heated. Fuel can be automatically refilled through a conveyor belt.

name: Table Saw
description: It consumes Logs to produce planks, with one conveyor belt input and one conveyor belt output.

name: Thermal Extractor
description: An advanced Extractor with an added heating module. The higher up it's built, the greater its output.

name: World Tree Nursery
description: A Nursery used specially to grow a World Tree. It consumes Fertilizer at a set rate and has nine conveyor belt inputs and one conveyor belt output.
